title: tables.v1 - tables found on document pages
description: Optional top-level `tables` array of a cli_output.v1 document (v1 allows extra top-level keys, so v1 consumers are unaffected). Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in ORIGINAL (unpreprocessed) page pixel coordinates; for PDFs the page rasterised at loader.pdf_dpi.

method.description: ruled = horizontal and vertical rules; rules_only = horizontal rules, columns from word gaps; aligned = borderless, columns from word gaps

section.description: report section the table sits in (findings, ...), null outside sections

cells.description: row-major; row 0 is usually the header row
